description: This file defines a PHP class 'ReturnReason' within the Opencart admin event namespace. The class extends a core Controller and contains an 'index' method that adds a task related to return reasons in the Opencart system.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: A controller class within the Opencart admin event namespace that manages adding a task for generating return reason lists.
